interpretation: Interventional sensitivity under declared perturbations and retrospective probability decomposition; not an internal causal explanation.

methods.output: candidate entropy contribution and optional local calibrator Jacobian sensitivity
methods.top_k: observed -p log(p) contribution with missing-mass disclosure

warnings: Attributions are conditional on the frozen ontology, prompt instrument, perturbation family, model, tokenizer, and calibrator.
A ranked token or span should not be described as the universal cause of model error.
Incomplete top-k probability mass yields partial rather than exact output attribution.
example: SPY/SGOV current US broad-equity market-state benchmark
prompt_attribution_scope: Whole-prompt information-equivalent variants; not individual prompt-token deletion.
output_attribution_scope: Returned candidate codes and top-k tokens from stored provider responses.
verbalizer_rationale: Single-token codes control tokenization and phrase-length effects. They are measurement instruments, not semantic states; reporting layers should display both code and state.
